I didn't realize that the president and vice president were going to turn me into the main character of the midterms. I didn't run for that. 
I ran because I want to serve this great state in the same way that I've been serving in different roles in public health.
They ran a very ugly campaign, and they purposely tried to divide us. And I think what Michiganders showed is just how big we really are. 
We reject that kind of division. We believe in a politics that puts us in the driver's seat, and we want to be able to afford our gas and groceries. It's really not that hard.
